product.name: Running & Cycling Club Finder
product.tagline: Discover and join local running and cycling groups; plan group rides and share Strava logs

sections.problem_statement: Urban fitness enthusiasts in India struggle to find vetted, active, and skill-matched running or cycling groups, often relying on fragmented, unmoderated WhatsApp groups. Existing platforms like Facebook Groups or Meetup lack deep integration with performance data, making it difficult to assess group compatibility based on pace or ride intensity. This product uniquely solves the discovery gap by combining location-based community matching with Strava-synced performance verification to ensure members align with group fitness levels.
target_users: Rahul, Software Engineer at TCS, struggles to find weekend cyclists in Bengaluru who match his 25km/h average speed.
Priya, Marketing Manager at a D2C startup, wants to join a safe, women-only running group in Mumbai for early morning training.
Vikram, a retired Corporate Executive, wants to mentor new cyclists but finds it hard to locate beginners who are serious about long-term training.
user_stories: As a beginner runner, I want to filter groups by 'pace' and 'location' so that I can join a group that matches my current fitness level without feeling intimidated.
As a cycling club admin, I want to verify member stats via Strava API so that I can maintain the safety and performance standards of my group rides.
As a fitness enthusiast, I want to RSVP for specific group events so that I can commit to a schedule and track my weekly consistency.
As a group member, I want to receive real-time notifications about route changes or weather alerts so that I don't travel to a cancelled session.
As a user concerned about privacy, I want to mask my exact home address on the group map so that I comply with DPDP Act standards regarding personal location data.
mvp_features: Smart Discovery Engine: Location-based search with filters for pace, distance, and activity type (Running vs. Cycling).
Strava Integration: Seamless OAuth flow to pull performance metrics, allowing users to showcase their fitness level on their profile.
Event Management: A simple calendar interface for admins to post rides/runs and for members to RSVP, reducing coordination overhead.
Privacy-First Profiles: Granular settings to control what performance and location data is visible to non-members, aligned with the DPDP Act.
Club Feed: A dedicated space for club admins to post route maps (GPX/TCX) and safety guidelines for upcoming events.
In-App Messaging: Restricted chat channels per group to minimize spam and keep communication focused on logistics.
future_features: In-app emergency SOS button that sends live location to group admins during rides for safety.
Gamified leaderboards for club members to encourage healthy competition and retention.
Premium coaching marketplace where certified trainers can offer paid training plans to club members.
E-commerce integration for local bike shops to offer exclusive discounts to verified club members.
success_metrics: Monthly Active Users (MAU): 10,000 users within 6 months — indicates product-market fit and community stickiness.
Retention Rate: 40% of users joining at least 2 events per month by end of Q2 — measures long-term engagement.
Conversion Rate: 15% of users connecting their Strava account — measures the value of performance-based matching.
Club Growth: 500 active clubs onboarded within 4 months — ensures the supply side of the marketplace is healthy.
assumptions: Users are willing to link their Strava accounts to gain access to higher-quality, performance-matched groups.
The Indian urban fitness market has a high enough density of runners and cyclists to make location-based matching effective.
Group admins are willing to migrate from WhatsApp to a structured platform if it reduces their administrative burden.
risks: Privacy concerns regarding location data → Implement strict data masking and explicit consent prompts compliant with the DPDP Act.
Platform abandonment in favor of WhatsApp → Focus on high-value features like event scheduling and performance verification that WhatsApp cannot provide.
Safety incidents during group events → Include mandatory liability waivers and community guidelines as part of the onboarding process.
sections.go_to_market: Launch via partnerships with local cycling cafes and running stores in major metros like Bengaluru and Mumbai. Utilize micro-influencer campaigns on Instagram and Strava to build early trust. Execute a 'Founding Club' program where the first 100 clubs get premium badges and administrative tools for free.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Use a no-code stack like Bubble.io or FlutterFlow for rapid iteration and UI flexibility. Integrate Strava API for fitness data and Firebase for real-time event updates and secure authentication. Use Mapbox for location-based clustering to ensure high-performance map rendering.
sections.monetisation: Freemium model with a 'Pro' tier at ₹199/month offering advanced performance analytics and priority access to popular events. Clubs pay a nominal subscription of ₹499/month for advanced event scheduling and member management tools. Future revenue will come from affiliate commissions on bike maintenance services and fitness gear.
